hints.title: Points at Origin
hints.text: Points identical to your current location are always visible regardless of angle.

hints.title: Convert to Polar Angles
hints.text: Compute arctangent of each point relative to location and sort resulting degree angles.

hints.title: Wrap Around and Sliding Window
hints.text: Duplicate angles by adding 360 degrees to handle full circle boundary then use a sliding window.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every possible continuous angle orientation takes quadratic or infinite time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting angles enables a two-pointer sliding window in linear time after O(n log n) sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle points sitting exactly at the viewer location and 360-degree wrap-around.
